note: Three hand-authored personas for the Pediatric Assessment developmental-screen engine. calculateDevelopmentalScreen(state) returns overallResult ('developmental-delay' if any fired rule has result 'fail', else 'developmental-concern' if any has 'concern', else 'normal'), domainResults for the five core domains, and firedRules in catalogue order (GM, FM, LG, SE, CG, GR, BH, FH, IM, SB, MH). Split engine: form-app.js calls detectAdditionalFlags(state) separately, so flags are pinned as expected.additionalFlags with flagsArgs ["state"]; the detector pushes in source order then stable-sorts high > medium > low. Quirks verified: an unanswered ('') developmental domain is reported as 'pass' in domainResults (grader default) and fires no rule; every threshold is strict (<37 weeks, <32 weeks, <7 Apgar, <3rd percentile, >4 h screen time), so 37 / 7 / 3 / 4 are all silent; overallResult ignores the flags entirely, so a form can be 'normal' while carrying medium-priority flags; anaphylaxis flags are indexed by allergy array position (FLAG-ALLERGY-ANAPH-<i>) and are followed by an unconditional FLAG-ALLERGY-001 count flag whenever any allergy exists; nicuDuration 0 is falsy so the NICU message omits the day count. Regenerate expected with: bin/test-personas pediatric-assessment --update

personas.name: Healthy 3-year-old - routine development review, nothing fires
personas.description: Baseline / best case: a term (40-week) child with Apgar 9/9, no NICU, growth on the 50th centiles, every developmental domain 'pass', immunisations up to date, no medical, family, or social concerns, no allergies, screen time 1 h/day. Expect overallResult 'normal', domainResults all 'pass', firedRules [] and additionalFlags [].

personas.name: Boundary values everywhere - 37 weeks, Apgar 7, 3rd centile, 4 h screen, milestones unassessed
personas.description: Non-critical edge case: every numeric sits exactly ON a strict threshold so nothing fires - gestational age 37 (rule is <37), 5-minute Apgar 7 (<7), weight and head-circumference percentiles 3 (<3), screen time 4 (>4). The five developmental domains are left unanswered ('') because the 8-month-old was asleep, so the grader defaults each to 'pass' in domainResults without firing any rule. Immunisations are up to date but a previous vaccine adverse reaction (fever/irritability after 8-week DTaP) is recorded, and one mild egg allergy is documented. Expect overallResult 'normal', firedRules [], domainResults all 'pass', and two medium flags in push order: FLAG-IMMUN-002 then FLAG-ALLERGY-001 ('1 allergy/allergies documented'). No anaphylaxis flag because severity is 'mild'.

personas.name: Ex-30-week preterm toddler - failure to thrive, global delay, safeguarding, anaphylaxis
personas.description: Critical / highest-severity persona: born at 30 weeks (fires BOTH BH-002 preterm and BH-003 very-preterm), 45-day NICU stay, 5-minute Apgar 5, birth complications, weight on the 1st and head circumference on the 2nd centile with failure to thrive, gross motor and language 'fail', fine motor and social-emotional 'concern', cognitive 'pass', immunisations behind, chronic BPD, recurring chest infections, penicillin anaphylaxis (index 0) plus mild egg allergy, family genetic condition, family developmental disorder, consanguinity, behavioural concerns, an open safeguarding concern and 6 h/day screen time. Expect overallResult 'developmental-delay'; domainResults GM fail / FM concern / LG fail / SE concern / CG pass; 18 fired rules in catalogue order GM-002, FM-001, LG-002, SE-001, GR-001, GR-002, GR-003, BH-001, BH-002, BH-003, BH-004, FH-001, FH-002, IM-001, SB-001, SB-003, MH-001, MH-002 (SB-002 silent because schoolPerformance is 'not-applicable'); and 19 flags after the stable sort - high: FLAG-FTT-001, FLAG-GROWTH-001, FLAG-GROWTH-002, FLAG-DEV-001, FLAG-SAFEGUARD-001, FLAG-PRETERM-001 (high because <32), FLAG-ALLERGY-ANAPH-0; medium: FLAG-IMMUN-001, FLAG-DEV-002, FLAG-NICU-001 ('(45 days)'), FLAG-APGAR-001, FLAG-BIRTH-001, FLAG-ALLERGY-001, FLAG-CHRONIC-001, FLAG-INFECTION-001, FLAG-GENETIC-001, FLAG-CONSANG-001, FLAG-BEHAV-001; low: FLAG-SCREEN-001.
